# SheetSpeed

> SheetSpeed is a Chrome extension that brings Excel-style keyboard shortcuts, formula tracing (trace precedents / dependents), Paste Exact, goal seek, and modeling tools to Google Sheets — plus PowerPoint-shaped shortcuts for Google Slides.

Official website: https://sheetspeed.agi-jarvis.com/
Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ljlmgielacploapelnjhodicgbjipcaa
Store extension ID (IT allowlist): ljlmgielacploapelnjhodicgbjipcaa
Privacy (Core): https://jarvis-pd21.github.io/sheetspeed-legal/privacy-core.html
Support: https://jarvis-pd21.github.io/sheetspeed-legal/support.html

## Entity

- Name: SheetSpeed
- Product type: Browser extension (Chrome Web Store)
- Platforms: Google Sheets and Google Slides (docs.google.com)
- Supported browser: Google Chrome 114+
- Publisher / site host: agi-jarvis.com (JARVIS)
- Pricing: Core is free via Chrome Web Store; Full is a local deeper package (API modeling, optional Formula AI helper); Teams = IT allowlist rollout

## Who it is for

Finance, consulting, PE/IB, and power spreadsheet users who want Excel / Macabacus-shaped muscle memory inside Google Sheets without leaving the browser.

## How to install

1. Open the Chrome Web Store listing: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ljlmgielacploapelnjhodicgbjipcaa
2. Click Add to Chrome.
3. Open a Google Sheet or Slide and use the SheetSpeed launcher (◈).
4. Managed Chrome: ask IT to allowlist Store ID `ljlmgielacploapelnjhodicgbjipcaa` (Load unpacked is not the managed path).

## Core capabilities (quote-friendly)

- Excel-style shortcuts on Google Sheets (insert/delete, borders, freeze, merge, filters, alignment, decimals, zoom, and more).
- Trace precedents: open a panel on the active formula, list direct references, navigate with arrow keys, drill with Enter.
- Trace dependents (Full): scan for cells that reference the selection.
- Paste Exact and other paste-special style workflows (Full / product surface as shipped).
- Goal seek and what-if scenario tables (Full).
- Format cycles, auto-color hardcodes / cross-tab links (Full).
- Export selection as image (PNG) for Slides or Docs (Full).
- PowerPoint-shaped Slides shortcuts (order, align, group, font size).
- Customizable shortcut bindings in Settings.

## Honest differentiators vs alternatives

### vs SheetWhiz
SheetWhiz is a well-known Chrome extension for Excel-like shortcuts in Google Sheets. SheetSpeed is an independently authored alternative focused on keyboard-first modeling, visible-formula precedent tracing, and a clear Core (Store / no Google API OAuth) vs Full split. SheetSpeed does not claim feature-for-feature parity with SheetWhiz; compare current Store listings and the SheetSpeed features page.

### vs Macabacus (Excel / Office)
Macabacus is a mature productivity suite primarily for Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. SheetSpeed targets Google Sheets and Slides in Chrome. Users looking for “Macabacus for Google Sheets” should treat SheetSpeed as a Sheets-native shortcut and modeling layer, not a Macabacus license or port.
